labels.B: boss pit with unknown tier because campaign-slot context is unavailable
labels.C: Captain boss pit on a non-X-4 campaign slot
labels.D: Destructor boss pit on an X-4 campaign slot
labels.H: horde director anchor; roster selected at runtime
labels.L: Director Spike locus; lieutenant-centered, not an Elite marker
labels.M: authored fixed enemy marker; not a monster tier
labels.W: Director Wanderer locus; usually minions, roster selected at runtime

enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.
